scope: weighted H22 fibre of component nineteen on the finite special divisor q=0 over Q(p,phi), restricted to p*phi*(phi^2-1)!=0
method: fresh q=0 plane reconstruction, exact characteristic-zero permanents and squarefree pair minors, direct finite/infinity homogeneous contractions, bidirectional Singular projection-ideal equality, a complete shared extension frame, and one fixed transverse marked minor

expected.conclusion: weighted H22 fibre empty on the stated open

boundaries.p=0: the pure coefficient 4*p vanishes and the mode-zero intrinsic basis change degenerates
boundaries.phi=0: outside the component parameter torus; h0=1/phi and the shared frame are undefined
boundaries.phi=1 or phi=-1: the 29x8 shared unwanted matrix drops from rank 6 to rank 5; not settled here
boundaries.C=0: both required D23 binary diagonals are not genuine
boundaries.p*D-phi*t*C=0: the required D01 pure diagonal vanishes
boundaries.projective opposite-plane boundary: not part of this finite q=0 chart calculation

limitations: Independently verified on the stated open; the construction discovery label remains CANDIDATE.
Only the q=0 finite component chart with p*phi*(phi^2-1)!=0 is covered.
The phi=1 and phi=-1 sub-divisors have a genuine shared-kernel rank jump and remain open.
No claim is made for projective opposite-plane boundaries, component exhaustiveness, arbitrary-order local-to-global reduction, the prize graph, or the global Krenn-Gu conjecture.
